edges: An assembly of Afghans swore allegiance to Mullah Mohammed Omar during a meeting.
Mullah Mohammed Omar's preferred weapon of choice was the RPG-7.
Mullah Mohammed Omar was allied with Osama bin Laden during the Taliban's rule.
Mullah Mohammed Omar disappeared after a U.S.-led bombing campaign routed the Taliban from Kabul.
Mullah Mohammed Omar is the leader of the Taliban's self-declared Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.
